مِجْشَبٌ Big, or bulky, and courageous, brave, or bold. (IAar, K.) ＝
-A2- [Also, accord. to Golius, as on the authority of Ibn-Maaroof, but in this case probably a mistranscription for مِشْجَبٌ, A wooden thing upon which clothes are put.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
